windows.role: winter peak = annual observed residual peak
limited hold-out (not unseen by the v1.6 annual calibration)

load.unit: MW hourly average (= MWh per hour)
load.regional_split: weather zone -> bus: v1.6 COUNTY_TO_BUS_SHARES (lpf x substation share)
load.demand_concept: ERCOT native load (actual 2025), not CDR firm load

renewables.model_input: v1.6 network p_max_pu (PyPSA-USA profiles) of the 3 h step containing each source row, held for 3 h
renewables.observed_output: derived settlement wind / solar = ACTUAL OUTPUT incl. curtailment, used only for QA and event choice, NOT as p_max_pu
renewables.note: model profiles are not the 2025 weather; load and renewables are a cross-year stress combination

time.label: ERCOT source HE labels (Central prevailing time as published); no UTC conversion claimed; no DST hour fabricated
time.resampling: none (1 h source rows); the 3 h step index is only used to pick p_max_pu
time.model_snapshot: period = block x window (1..6), timestep = source date + HE hours (label only)

thermal_availability: v1.6 template p_max_pu; MORA outage quantiles NOT applied (ex-ante marginals, not joint; not authorised)
power_energy_units: MW for power, MWh for energy, 1 h snapshots, weight 1
